WITH per_patient AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
    AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE UA > 3.9
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS average_of_patient_avg_hgb,
       AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS average_of_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt
FROM per_patient;
